snippet.title: Father - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Demo Trailer for Father, a psychological story-rich horror game developed by Wetboxteam. Players will see the lives of a family living in isolation and under the rule of an unforgiving and stern father. Uphold the demands as the father himself to maintain sanity in Father, coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
